prompt:
主題：
鏡前の白と銀鎖

主体：
画面中央、暖色ランプのある鏡台へ両手をついて立つ若い女性。白い深開きカーディガントップ、グレージュのプリーツミニスカート、腰の銀チェーン、右肩の黒バッグが主役。

人物・表情：
細い卵形の顔、小さな顎、明るい茶色の切れ長の瞳、細い眉、短い鼻筋、艶のある淡桃色の唇。顔を少し左へ傾け、正面のカメラへ落ち着いた視線と控えめな表情を向ける。明るいブラウンの肩下ウェーブ髪は中央寄りの薄い前髪と頬沿いの毛束。

服装・ポーズ：
白い細かな立体編みの長袖カーディガントップは胸元を深く開け、小さな真珠風ボタン数個だけで留め、袖口は広くフレア。グレージュの低いウエストベルト付きプリーツミニスカート、銀チェーン飾り、黒い肩掛けバッグ。腰を左へ傾け、両腕を下へ伸ばし鏡台に手をつく。

背景・光：
画面左に白い壁と布シェードの卓上ランプ、中央背景に影、画面右に黒枠の楕円鏡、濃茶の台、香水瓶。左下の暖かなランプと正面の柔らかな補助光が顔と白布を照らし、壁へ人物の影を落とす。

構図・カメラ：
4:5の縦構図、腰の高さより少し上の正面カメラで頭頂から腿中央までを収める三分身ポートレート。人物を中央へ大きく、鏡を右上、ランプを左下へ配置。腿は下端で裁切し、瞳と服の構造にピント、鏡奥は軽くぼかす。

質感・スタイル：
フォトリアルな実写写真。白い編み地、プリーツ、金属チェーン、黒革、自然な肌と髪を高精細にし、白、灰褐色、黒を暖かな室内光でまとめる。

ネガティブ：
白トップと銀鎖省略；腰傾けポーズ変更

promptTranslations.en:
Subject:
White and Silver Chains Before the Mirror

Main Subject:
In the center of the frame, a young woman stands leaning with both hands on a vanity table with a warm-toned lamp. The focal points are her white, deeply unbuttoned cardigan top, greige pleated miniskirt, silver waist chain, and black bag on her right shoulder.

Person and Facial Expression:
Slender oval face, small chin, light brown almond-shaped eyes, thin eyebrows, short bridge of the nose, and glossy pale pink lips. With her face tilted slightly to the left, she directs a calm gaze and an understated expression toward the front-facing camera. Light brown wavy hair reaching past the shoulders, with wispy bangs centered and strands flowing along her cheeks.

Attire and Pose:
A white, fine-textured knit long-sleeved cardigan top with a deeply open neckline, fastened by only a few small pearl-like buttons, featuring wide flared cuffs. A greige pleated miniskirt with a low-waist belt, silver chain embellishment, and a black shoulder bag. Her hips are tilted to the left, both arms extended downward with hands resting on the vanity table.

Background and Lighting:
On the left side of the frame are a white wall and a table lamp with a fabric shade, shadows in the center background, and on the right side of the frame are a black-framed oval mirror, a dark brown vanity surface, and perfume bottles. The warm lamp light from the lower left and soft frontal fill light illuminate her face and the white fabric, casting the subject's shadow onto the wall.

Composition and Camera:
4:5 vertical composition, three-quarter portrait capturing from the top of the head to the mid-thigh via a frontal camera positioned slightly above waist level. The subject is framed prominently in the center, with the mirror positioned at the upper right and the lamp at the lower left. The thighs are cropped at the bottom edge; sharp focus on the eyes and fabric texture, with the background inside the mirror softly blurred.

Texture and Style:
Photorealistic live-action photograph. High-definition rendering of the white knit texture, pleats, metal chains, black leather, natural skin, and hair, harmonizing white, taupe-gray, and black under warm indoor lighting.

Negative:
Omission of white top and silver chain; alteration of the hip-tilted pose

summaryTranslations.en: Photorealistic portrait of a young woman wearing a white deep-neck cardigan and a miniskirt with silver chains in front of a vanity table.

summaryEn: Photorealistic indoor portrait of a young woman posing before a vanity mirror wearing an open white knit cardigan and a taupe pleated mini skirt with a silver chain.

translations.zh:
主题：
镜前的白衣与银链

主体：
画面中央，双手撑在有暖色台灯的梳妆台前的年轻女性。以白色深V针织开衫、灰褐色百褶超短裙、腰间银链及右肩黑色单肩包为主体。

人物与表情：
纤细瓜子脸，小下巴，浅棕色凤眼，细眉，短鼻梁，微带光泽的淡粉色双唇。头部微向左倾，目光平静投向正前方的镜头。浅棕色过肩卷发配轻薄刘海。

服装与姿势：
白色立体纹理长袖针织开衫，胸口大面积深开，微系几颗小珍珠纽扣，宽袖口设计。低腰带灰褐色百褶短裙，配银色链条，身背黑包。臀部微倾，双手下撑梳妆台。

背景与光影：
左侧为白墙与暖光布罩台灯，右侧置有黑框椭圆镜、深棕色梳妆台及香水瓶。暖色台灯与正面柔光打亮主体，在墙面投下阴影。

构图与镜头：
4:5纵向构图，腰部略上方正前机位中景半身人像。主体居中放大，镜子在右上，台灯在左下。聚焦双眸与服装细节。

质感与风格：
逼真写实摄影。高精细度展现针织肌理、金属链、皮革与肤发，暖色室内光调和白、灰褐与黑色调。

负面提示：
省略白色上衣与银链；改变侧倾姿态
translations.en:
Theme:
White top and silver chain in front of the mirror

Subject:
A young woman resting both hands on a vanity with a warm lamp in the center of the frame. Dressed in a low-cut white cardigan top, taupe pleated mini skirt, silver waist chain, and a black shoulder bag.

Subject Details & Expression:
Slender oval face, small chin, hazel almond eyes, thin eyebrows, glossy soft pink lips. Head tilted slightly to the left, gazing calmly at the camera. Light brown wavy hair past shoulders with light bangs.

Outfit & Pose:
White fine-knit long-sleeve cardigan with an open front fastened by tiny pearl buttons, flared cuffs. Low-waist taupe pleated skirt with silver chain accent and black shoulder bag. Leaning slightly to the left, resting both hands down on the vanity table.

Background & Lighting:
White wall and fabric-shade lamp on the left, dark-framed oval mirror, dark vanity, and perfume bottles on the right. Warm ambient lamp light and soft frontal fill illumination creating soft wall shadows.

Composition & Camera:
4:5 vertical framing, eye-level half-body portrait from head to mid-thigh. Main subject centered, mirror upper-right, lamp lower-left. Shallow depth of field on the background.

Texture & Style:
Photorealistic photo. High-fidelity textures of knitwear, pleats, metallic chain, leather, and skin in warm indoor lighting.

Negative:
Missing white top and silver chain; modified leaning pose
